entities.name: PMID:25431032
observations: Reported short-TE (20 ms) 3D proton EPSI at 3 T for quantitative whole-brain metabolite mapping in 10 healthy volunteers.
Water-referenced mM maps were corrected for B1+, B1−, and B0; reported NAA, choline, creatine, and myo-inositol. Coverage was characterized using two acquisition orientations.

entities.name: Short-TE whole-brain MRSI
observations: In 10 healthy volunteers, 3 T 3D EPSI at TE 20 ms yielded water-referenced concentration maps (mM) for NAA, choline, creatine, and myo-inositol after B1+, B1−, and B0 correction.
